trust_decision.summary: A component instance is single-use: at the render boundary (`ViewComponent::Base#render_in`) every view-context-derived ivar is refreshed on each call and a second render raises `ViewComponent::ReusedInstanceError` (configurable to warn only).

landing_point.why: An engineer reading "reused component instances retain stale render context" looks first at #render_in, where @__vc_original_view_context, @lookup_context, @view_flow and @__vc_requested_details are memoized with `||=` and where @__vc_controller/@__vc_helpers/@__vc_request are first derived.

fix_sites.module_kind: core component base class, new guard helpers

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A Collection is built from the collection argument and is not "a component instance"; its memoized @components reads as a performance cache and the spacer as caller-supplied configuration, so the reuse in Collection#render_in looks like framework plumbing the advisory is not about.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Content and slots set by the caller before render (`with_content`, `with_*_slot`) share the instance-variable namespace with the render-scoped ivars; a reset that clears every ivar (or dup-ing the instance) drops them and the component renders without its caller-supplied content - the published fix deliberately preserves @__vc_set_slots and @__vc_content_set_by_with_content.

O6_input_shapes: the same component instance rendered a second time through #render_in
the same instance aliased into two positions of one parent (inline items array)
the same Collection object rendered twice (children rebuilt per render)
a Collection with a caller-supplied spacer_component rendered twice (spacer dup'd before render)
guard disabled via config (`raise_on_reused_instances = false`): warning instead of raise, state still refreshed

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Slot#to_s caches its rendered HTML in @content and never invalidates it; slot objects live in @__vc_set_slots, which the fix deliberately preserves, so a second render of the same instance replays the previous render's slot output and the child component's new guard never fires because render_in is not called again
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Slot state is the thing the fix explicitly declares caller-owned and preserved, so its cached HTML looks like caller data rather than render context
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: 1 file from the landing point (lib/view_component/slot.rb), same gem package; the advisory never mentions slots

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Public accessors #controller, #helpers, #request (and the delegates onto helpers: output_buffer, lookup_context, view_flow) keep answering from the previous render's view context after the render ends: render_in's ensure restores only @virtual_path and @current_template, and @view_context plus @__vc_controller/@__vc_helpers/@__vc_request are cleared only at the start of the next render, so a retained instance exposes the old request with no second render for the guard to catch
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The accessors are documented as valid inside a render and no reuse happens on this route, so it looks outside the advisory's "rendered a second time" framing
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the landing point, ~200 lines below it

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a per-render invalidation of a Slot's cached @content, mirroring __vc_reset_render_state!
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: slots hold child component instances and rendered HTML produced during a render, so the same reset a maintainer wrote for the component is a natural thing to write for the slot wrapper

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second retained-instance path beside the spacer (a memoized per-item wrapper or an options/iterator object the collection keeps)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Collection already holds instances long-term and the fix had to special-case the spacer, so another retention path next to it is a plausible follow-on feature

O8b_injection_room.sibling: caching the default-method slot (which today is rebuilt on each call) in @__vc_set_slots
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: caching a slot built by a default method is an obvious performance change and would recreate exactly the stale-state mechanism the advisory is about

O9_family: cross-request/session data exposure through mutable instance state retained on a reused object (CWE-362 race on shared state, CWE-488 exposure to the wrong session, CWE-668 exposure to the wrong sphere)

O10_build.toolchain: Ruby 4.0 + bundler + rake + appraisal (Gemfile, gemfiles/rails_*.gemfile); Rails 8.1 by default, native gems (nokogiri) compiled at install
O10_build.project_tests: Minitest under test/sandbox/test (rendering_test.rb, collection_test.rb, slot_test.rb); `bundle exec rake test` / `rake all_tests`

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Replace the `||=` memoization in Base#render_in with plain assignment (refresh controller/helpers/request/lookup_context/view_flow) and stop there, leaving Collection, the spacer and slot content untouched
